Concept name: 清爽现代. Product visual system: luminous white #FFFFFF and subtle mist #F7F9FC, ink #18232C, blue #2463EB, restrained aqua, 12px rounded corners, thin pale separators, almost no shadows. Compact LIGHT left navigation 184px with clean linear icons, minimal “同路” brand, selected navigation blue background. Top utility bar with trip switch “一起去毕业旅行”, 示例, 本地保存 and 分享. Mature yet young and fresh, Swiss typography meets contemporary travel planning.

Concept name: 旅行杂志. Entirely different layout and visual language from modern SaaS. Warm editorial WHITE #FCFBF8 (not beige), charcoal ink #232A28, muted terracotta #B95539 sparingly, soft olive details, high-end travel publication. Use horizontal TOP navigation instead of sidebar. Top line: minimalist typographic 同路 at left, center four links 小队 / 方案 / 日程 / 账本, right small 本地保存 and 分享. Thin underline selected 小队. No decorative stamps, torn-paper scrapbook gimmicks or artificial texture. Refined modern sans serif Chinese, sophisticated larger headings and generous magazine-like grid. Crisp 1px rules, square-ish photos, 6px controls, restrained editorial asymmetry.
Screen 小队. Main content margins64, top small trip selector 一起去毕业旅行 · 示例. Main composition 38% left visual/editorial column, 62% right roster. Present six spacious horizontal roster rows, not a card grid.
